bends.reason: B1 is one of the two bends of the front-flange joggle (pairs with B2). In the section the scan follows the blue profile: the S-offset at about x=+3 mm, the flange tail at y of about -2 to -4 mm, and the separate end strip at (-12..-9, -6..-4) all lie on blue, within about 0.7 mm. There are no points near the orange tail, which tilts about 25 deg up to y +1..+3.5, or near the orange strip at y +2..+3.5. The same joggle S-step also shows up in the scan in the B8 and B9 sections.

B2 is the second bend of the front joggle. The scan's short tail (x -8..0) with its dip to y of about -2.5, and the separate end strip at (-15..-12, +1..+3), sit on the blue profile. There are no points on the orange tail, which tilts about 35 deg up, or on the orange strip near (-10,+9). The parent flange matches exactly.

B3 is the back-flange joggle bend (pairs with B4) and mirrors B1. The scan follows blue: the S-offset near x=+3, the tail, and the end strip at (-12..-9, -6..-4). The orange tilted tail and the orange strip at y +2..+3.5 have no points. The joggle step is also visible in the scan in the B6 and B11 sections.

B4 is the second back-joggle bend and mirrors B2. The scan's tail and end strip at (-15..-12, +1..+3) coincide with blue. The orange tail, about 35 deg up, and the orange strip at about (-10,+9) have no points.

B5 is the 11-12 mm return at the free edge of the left short wall (B10). The scan follows blue along the 41 mm wall, the 90 deg corner into the plate, and the return turning about 90 deg to (-8,-9.5). No points lie along the orange straight continuation. The B10 section separately shows this return formed at the CAD position, and the raw SIDE view shows inward return feet on both short walls.

B6 is the fold line on the back long flange. The scan runs straight through the bend line along orange for about 21 mm, then reproduces the orange joggle S-step and the separate end strip at (-25..-22, +20..+22) exactly. No points lie along the blue folded profile. The raw TOP and FRONT views show the back long flange lying flat. Note: this reference's parent is a straight segment of 75 mm or more, so it was drawn with B11 flat rather than from the all-formed CAD. This does not affect the verdict.

B7 is the return at the free edge of the right short wall (B12). The scan in the B7 section has exactly the formed shape: an 11 mm return turning 90 deg in the blue direction, a 41 mm wall, and a 90 deg corner into the plate. The whole profile is rigidly shifted about 12 mm along the wall relative to the blue reference. Because the plate corner is shifted by the same amount, this looks like a local re-fit/registration offset, not a short wall. No points lie along the orange straight continuation. Independent support: the B12 section shows this return formed exactly at the CAD position, and the raw SIDE view shows inward feet on both short walls.

B8 is the fold line on the front long flange and mirrors B6. The scan continues straight through the bend line along orange, with the joggle S-step and the separate end strip at the orange positions. The blue folded profile has no points. The raw FRONT view shows flat flanges extending about 74 mm on both sides of the standing short walls. Note: as with B6, the reference was drawn with the neighbouring B9 flat (straight parent of 75 mm or more). This does not affect the verdict.

B9 is the main bend on the front long side. Past the bend line the scan stays in the plane of the 35 mm window band, along orange, for about 62 mm to the joggle and end strip, all matching orange. No points lie along the blue 90 deg wall. The raw TOP view shows bands about 100 mm wide on both long sides, against about 36 mm on the short sides. The overlay TOP and SIDE views show the scan extending flat beyond the CAD frame past B9 and B11.

B10 is the left short wall. The scan follows blue exactly: the 35 mm band, a 40 mm wall at 90 deg, and the 11 mm return at its end. The orange flat continuation and its return have no points. The raw SIDE and FRONT views show the short walls standing, with return feet.

B11 is the main bend on the back long side and mirrors B9. Past the bend line the scan stays flat along orange for about 62 mm to the joggle and end strip. The blue 90 deg wall has no points. This matches the wide flat band on that side in the raw TOP view and the overlay TOP and SIDE views.

B12 is the right short wall and mirrors B10. The scan lies on the blue 35 mm band, the 40 mm wall at 90 deg, and the 11 mm return (which is the B7 flange, at the CAD position). The orange flat continuation has no points.
